notes.title: Sneak Peek: Stage 2 Update!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

As you all know, we’re not just releasing new Stages – the full game will also feature enhanced visuals and puzzles for Stages 1, 2, and 3. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/f615e2cc7391e174367551614e6be973c4d676cd.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/72fde28c03ea01d41accf5f4bb1a8c89f6a00730.png[/img]
In this updated Stage 2 puzzle, the Boy and El must flip boxes while avoiding the White Horseman and its hunting dog. 

Let us know what you think! 

- The Acts29Games team

tags.feature: enhanced visuals and puzzles for Stages 1, 2, and 3.

notes.title: 2 Horsemen, 3 Stages
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Each stage has a distinct art style, gameplay, and theme. Here’s a breakdown of the stages available for Early Access: 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/6d77f5c7ee4efe6e059001f66300cc605926ba52.png[/img] 
Stage 1 - Desolate desert with image-based puzzles, where the Boy finds hints of the Apocalypse 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/d4c2ca1bb257bda286105da369d8db331b1036aa.png[/img] 
Stage 2 - Shadowed farmland with trap puzzles, where the Boy encounters the White Horseman of Deception 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/0a41240677189002d5477af858b5c72fda8558b2.png[/img] 
Stage 3 - Burning towns with avoidance puzzle, where the Boy flees the Red Horseman of War 

Which stage are you enjoying the most? Which one is the most beautiful? Please share so we can make the next two stages even better!

- The Acts29Games team

notes.title: Four Diaspora Countries Language Support and Game Update
notes.content:
Hello.

I'm sending you an update of the diaspora.


[h1][b] Support for additional 4 languages [/b][/h1]

- Spanish, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), and Chinese (Traditional) Support for a total of four languages


[h2][b]Support settings while playing games[/b][/h2]

- You can now change the settings during the game.


[h2][b] Improve interaction delay [/b][/h2]

- Modify to move smoothly by reducing the area where the delay was after interaction


I will work hard for those who enjoy the diaspora.
I'm waiting for your feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: Support for controllers, improve convenience, and add key mapping capabilities
notes.content:
Hello.
I'm sending you an update of the diaspora.


[h1][b]Controller support[/b][/h1]
- XBOX Controller Support
- Support for PlayStation controllers


[h2][b]Add key mapping capabilities [/b][/h2]
- You can now change the way you operate in the settings.


[h2][b]Improve brightness[/b][/h2]
- Improving in-game brightness
- Improve invisible areas by adding light to areas that are hard to see due to dark environments


I will work hard for those who enjoy the diaspora.
I'm waiting for your feedback!

Thank you.
